description: Simplifies an overloaded existing UI: removes, merges or hides tabs, toggles, panels and duplicate controls, cuts choices, applies progressive disclosure and describes the leaner layout. Use when the user says a screen is cluttered or overwhelming, has too many options, tabs or settings, or asks to declutter or strip it down. Not for building in a minimalist visual style (use minimalist-ui).
